title: F01: Service skeleton: config, health, DB session, Dockerfile, pytest, CI
milestone: M1 Foundations
labels: backend
---
## Goal
A running FastAPI skeleton with config, health endpoint, DB session, Docker image, tests and the CI gates.

**Depends on:** F00
**Built by:** `backend-dev` (backend/, tests/); main session (Makefile, Dockerfile, CI)

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `GET /api/health` returns 200 `{status, db, llm, model}`, with `llm: down` when no model server runs
- [ ] All settings from `backend/configuration.md` load from env vars; `.env.example` lists them
- [ ] `make check` passes locally (ruff, pytest, import boundaries, OpenAPI drift)
- [ ] CI runs all 6 gates from 0010 and is green on the PR
- [ ] `docker build` and `docker run` work; the container runs as non-root and keeps data on `/data`
- [ ] `docs/openapi.json` is generated and drift-checked
- [ ] Branch protection on `main` requires these checks (student, on GitHub)

## Read first
- `docs/wiki/backend/README.md`, `modules.md`, `configuration.md`, `persistence.md`
- `docs/wiki/contracts/api-endpoints.md` (health row), `error-format.md`
- `docs/wiki/decisions/0005-fastapi-and-vanilla-js-single-container.md`, `0006-sqlite-behind-repository-layer.md`, `0010-ci-gates-before-merge.md`
